title: Why is iron associated with Shani Dev? The ancient belief, symbolism, and spiritual significance explained
description: Iron holds a special place in Shani Dev worship traditions across India. Devotees offer iron articles, symbolizing surrender and dedication to the god of justice. This practice reflects the Hindu concept of daan, emphasizing compassion and social responsibility. The metal's qualities of strength and endurance link to Shani Dev's role. Offering iron serves as a reminder of discipline, patience, and honesty in life.

title: World News | PM Modi Visits Indonesia's Ancient Prambanan Temple with President Prabowo, Offers Prayers
description: Get latest articles and stories on World at LatestLY. Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Indonesia's historic Prambanan Temple alongside President Prabowo Subianto on Wednesday. En route, Modi shared a spectacular chopper view of the UNESCO World Heritage landmark on X. The visit marks the formal launch of an India-backed conservation project restoring the 9th-century Hindu monument.
